```{r dash-application-health, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

# ============================================================
# CURRENT RUN
# ============================================================

current_run_id <- raw_data %>%
  distinct(run_id, sequence_num) %>%
  arrange(desc(sequence_num)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(run_id)

# ============================================================
# APPLICATION SUMMARY
# ============================================================

rt_summary <- get_run_rt_sla(current_run_id)

app_summary <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in%
      c("true", "yes", "1")
  ) %>%
  group_by(app_name) %>%
  summarise(

    transactions = n(),

    errors = sum(
      !is_pass,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    error_rate = round(
      errors /
      transactions * 100,
      2
    ),

    successful_transactions = sum(
      is_pass,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    duration_secs = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),

    throughput = round(
      successful_transactions /
      duration_secs,
      2
    ),

    p95 = round(
      quantile(
        elapsed,
        0.95,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      0
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ============================================================
# SCENARIO SLA SUMMARY
# ============================================================

app_scenario_summary <- NULL

app_scenario_summary <- tibble(
  app_name = character(),
  total_scenarios = numeric(),
  passed_scenarios = numeric(),
  failed_scenarios = numeric()
)

if (!is.null(rt_summary)) {

  app_scenario_summary <- rt_summary$all_labels %>%
    left_join(
      raw_data %>%
        filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
        distinct(
          label,
          thread_group,
          app_name
        ),
      by = "label"
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      app_name,
      thread_group
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      scenario_passed = all(passed),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(app_name) %>%
    summarise(

      total_scenarios = n(),

      passed_scenarios = sum(
        scenario_passed,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      failed_scenarios = sum(
        !scenario_passed,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

}

app_rt_breach_summary <- rt_summary$all_labels %>%
  left_join(
    raw_data %>%
      filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
      distinct(
        label,
        app_name
      ),
    by = "label"
  ) %>%
  filter(!passed) %>%
  group_by(app_name) %>%
  summarise(
    breach_count = n(),
    worst_label = label[which.max(breach_pct)],
    worst_actual = max(actual_rt, na.rm = TRUE),
    worst_sla = threshold[which.max(breach_pct)],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ============================================================
# APPLICATION TPS SLA
# ============================================================

app_error_summary <- app_summary %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(

    error_target =
      get_app_error_threshold(app_name),

    error_pass =
      error_rate <= error_target

  ) %>%
  ungroup()

app_tps_summary <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    run_id == current_run_id
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(
      trimws(as.character(success))
    ) %in% c(
      "true",
      "yes",
      "1"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(app_name) %>%
  summarise(

    successful_transactions =
      sum(is_pass),

    duration_secs = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        max(timestamp),
        min(timestamp),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),

    throughput = round(
      successful_transactions /
      duration_secs,
      2
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(

    throughput_target =
      get_app_tps_threshold(app_name),

    throughput_pass =
      throughput >= throughput_target

  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================================
# FINAL DATASET
# ============================================================

app_health <- app_summary %>%
  left_join(
    app_scenario_summary,
    by = "app_name"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    app_tps_summary %>%
      select(
        app_name,
        throughput_target,
        throughput_pass
      ),
    by = "app_name"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    app_error_summary %>%
      select(
        app_name,
        error_target,
        error_pass
      ),
    by = "app_name"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    app_rt_breach_summary,
    by = "app_name"
    ) %>%
  mutate(
    scenario_pass = ifelse(
        is.na(failed_scenarios),
        TRUE,
        failed_scenarios == 0
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# APPLICATION STATUS COUNTS
# ============================================================

app_health <- app_health %>%
  mutate(
    application_pass =
      throughput_pass &
      error_pass &
      scenario_pass
  )

applications_total <- nrow(app_health)

applications_passed <- sum(
  app_health$application_pass,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

applications_failed <-
  applications_total - applications_passed

health_summary_html <- sprintf(
  '
  <div style="
      display:flex;
      gap:20px;
      margin-bottom:10px;
      font-size:14px;
  ">
    <span class="total-app">
      Total Apps: %s
    </span>

    <span class="status-pass">
      Passing Apps: %s
    </span>

    <span class="status-fail">
      Failing Apps: %s
    </span>

  </div>
  ',
  
  applications_total,
  applications_passed,
  applications_failed
)

# ============================================================
# STATUS + TOOLTIP
# ============================================================

metric_badge <- function(
  value,
  passed,
  suffix = ""
) {

  sprintf(
    "<span class='%s'>%s%s</span>",
    ifelse(
      passed,
      "status-pass",
      "status-fail"
    ),
    value,
    suffix
  )

}

app_health$status_html <- mapply(

  function(
      throughput_pass,
      error_pass,
      scenario_pass,
      throughput,
      throughput_target,
      error_rate,
      error_target,
      failed_scenarios,
      total_scenarios,
      breach_count,
      worst_label,
      worst_actual,
      worst_sla
    ) {

      breach_count <- ifelse(
          is.na(breach_count),
          0,
          breach_count
        )

        worst_label <- ifelse(
          is.na(worst_label),
          "N/A",
          worst_label
        )

        worst_actual <- ifelse(
          is.na(worst_actual),
          0,
          worst_actual
        )

        worst_sla <- ifelse(
          is.na(worst_sla),
          0,
          worst_sla
        )

        failures <- c()

        if (!throughput_pass) {

            failures <- c(
                failures,
                sprintf(
                  paste(
                    "Throughput SLA Failed:",
                    "",
                    "- Actual: %.2f TPS",
                    "- Target: %.2f TPS",
                    sep = "\n"
                    ),
                  throughput,
                  throughput_target
                )
            )

        }

        if (!scenario_pass) {

            failures <- c(
              failures,
              sprintf(
                paste(
                  "Response Time SLA Failed:",
                  "",
                  "- %s of %s User Scenarios failed RT SLA",
                  "",
                  "- %s Transaction Breaches detected",
                  "",
                  "Worst Breach:",
                  "- %s",
                  "- Actual: %s ms",
                  "- SLA: %s ms",
                  sep = "\n"
                ),
                failed_scenarios,
                total_scenarios,
                breach_count,
                worst_label,
                format(round(worst_actual), big.mark = ","),
                format(round(worst_sla), big.mark = ",")
              )
            )

        }

        if (!error_pass) {

            failures <- c(
                failures,
                sprintf(
                  "Error Rate SLA Failed\n\nActual: %.2f%%\nTarget: %.2f%%",
                  error_rate,
                  error_target
                )
            )

        }

        tooltip <- paste(
          failures,
          collapse = "\n\n------------------\n\n"
        )

        if (length(failures) == 0) {

        return(
            "<span class='status-pass'>✅ PASS</span>"
        )

        }

        sprintf(
        "
        <span class='status-fail'>
            ❌ FAIL
        </span>
        <i class='fa fa-info-circle breach-tooltip'
            title='%s'></i>
        ",
        tooltip
        )

    },

    app_health$throughput_pass,
    app_health$error_pass,
    app_health$scenario_pass,
    app_health$throughput,
    app_health$throughput_target,
    app_health$error_rate,
    app_health$error_target,
    app_health$failed_scenarios,
    app_health$total_scenarios,
    app_health$breach_count,
    app_health$worst_label,
    app_health$worst_actual,
    app_health$worst_sla,

    SIMPLIFY = TRUE

)

app_health$scenario_html <- mapply(
  function(passed, total, scenario_pass) {

    if (is.na(passed) || is.na(total)) {
      return("<span class='status-na'>NA</span>")
    }

    metric_badge(
      sprintf("%s of %s", passed, total),
      scenario_pass
    )

  },
  app_health$passed_scenarios,
  app_health$total_scenarios,
  app_health$scenario_pass,
  SIMPLIFY = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# HTML ROWS
# ============================================================

rows_html <- paste(
  apply(
    app_health,
    1,
    function(r) {

      sprintf(
        "
        <tr>

          <td>%s</td>

          <td>%s</td>

          <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>

          <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>

          <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>

        </tr>
        ",

        r["app_name"],

        r["status_html"],

        metric_badge(
          sprintf(
            "%.2f TPS",
            as.numeric(r["throughput"])
          ),
          as.logical(
            r["throughput_pass"]
          )
        ),

        metric_badge(
          sprintf(
            "%s ms",
            format(
                round(as.numeric(r["p95"])),
                big.mark = ","
            )
          ),
          as.numeric(
            r["failed_scenarios"]
          ) == 0
        ),

        metric_badge(
            sprintf(
                "%.2f",
                as.numeric(r["error_rate"])
            ),
            as.logical(
                r["error_pass"]
            ),
            "%"
        )

      )

    }
  ),
  collapse = ""
)

rt_column_title <- "Response Time"

if (
  exists("rt_sla_config") &&
  !is.null(rt_sla_config$metric)
) {

  rt_column_title <- paste(
    toupper(rt_sla_config$metric),
    "Response Time"
  )

}

html_output <- sprintf(
'
<div class="sub-executive-summary">
<div style="
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
  ">
  <h3 class="section-header">
  Health Summary
  </h3>
  <i style="
        color:#6c757d;
        cursor:help;
        font-size:14px;
        margin-top:-2px;"
      class="fa fa-info-circle breach-tooltip"
      title="

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATOR (KPI) SUMMARY

Max Users
Peak concurrent virtual users executed during the test.

Apps Passed TPS SLA
Number of applications that met their throughput (TPS) SLA target.

Scenarios Passed P95 Response Time SLA
Number of scenarios that met the configured response time SLA.

Scenarios Passed Error SLA
Number of scenarios that met the configured error rate SLA.

--------------------------------------------------

FAILURE ANALYSIS

Primary Failure Drivers
Summary of the SLA breaches that contributed to the overall test failure.

Top Response Time Breaches
Scenarios or transactions with the largest response time SLA violations.

Top Error Contributors
Transactions that generated the highest number of errors during execution.

--------------------------------------------------

HEALTH SUMMARY

Application Health Summary
Application-level view of performance, showing overall SLA status and key metrics for each application.

Scenario Health Summary
Scenario-level view of performance, showing SLA compliance and key metrics for each business scenario.

Status
Overall PASS when all applicable SLAs are satisfied.
Overall FAIL when one or more SLAs are breached.

Avg. Throughput
Average successful transactions per second (TPS) achieved during the test.

P95 Response Time
95%% of completed transactions finished within this response time.

Error Rate
Percentage of failed transactions compared to total transactions executed.

--------------------------------------------------

CURRENT VS BASELINE COMPARISON

Current
Metrics from the latest test execution.

Baseline
Metrics from the reference test execution used for comparison.

Delta
Percentage change between the current and baseline executions.

">
    </i>
</div>

%s

<table class="scorecard-table">

<tr>
  <th>Application</th>
  <th>Status</th>
  <th class="numeric-header">Avg. Throughput</th>
  <th class="numeric-header">%s</th>
  <th class="numeric-header">Error Rate</th>
</tr>

%s

</table>

</div>
',
health_summary_html,
rt_column_title,
rows_html
)

HTML(html_output)
```
